stages.title: Your free trial is over
stages.body: Thanks for trying wordsmith for five days. It runs on cloud servers that cost real money every month, so keeping it going takes a DOGS membership on Buy Me a Coffee: $1 a month, or $5 a year for life.

stages.title: Alright. Same to you, pal.
stages.body: But honestly? I've been broke before too. I'm broke right now too. It's a dollar. The offer stands whenever you're ready.
